edges.reason: _transfer delegates bookkeeping to _tokenTransfer after checks.
_tokenTransfer forwards to the standard reflection transfer.
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from sender and adds rTransferAmount to recipient in _rOwned.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection fee.
_takeTeam credits the contract's _rOwned balance.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the from address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance accounting.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transfer invokes _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before updating allowance.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances[sender][spender].
approve writes the _allowances mapping through _approve.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth on qualifying sells, entering the external swap path.
swapTokensForEth calls the router swap with amountOutMin 0.
The external router swap can call back into transfer/_transfer; the inSwap flag only partially blocks re-entry.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to the fee wallet after swapping.
sendETHToFee performs the ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
The destination of the ETH send is _feeAddrWallet2.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
manualswap requires _msgSender() to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend requires _msgSender() to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
cooldown[to] is compared with and written from block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by onlyOwner.
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner.
nonosquare is guarded by onlyOwner.
delBot is guarded by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership reads and clears the _owner state variable.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading sets the uniswapV2Router state variable.
openTrading stores the newly created pair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading approves the pair token to the router with type(uint).max.
nonosquare marks addresses as bots in the owner-controlled blacklist.
delBot clears the bots flag for an owner-chosen address.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
The bots_ array entries are written into the bots blacklist.
The loop index i selects which blacklist entry is written.
notbot is the key cleared in the bots mapping.
onoff is stored into cooldownEnabled.
The from argument drives zero-address, bot and pair checks in _transfer.
The to argument drives cooldown, pair and exclusion checks in _transfer.
The amount argument is validated against _maxTxAmount and positivity.
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance from balanceOf(address(this)).
contractTokenBalance is passed as the swap input amount.
tokenAmount is the swap amount and approval amount.
The path array is supplied to the router swap call.
The amount parameter is forwarded to the ETH transfer.
The sender parameter is forwarded to _transfer and allowance deduction.
The recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
The amount parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
The sender parameter indexes _rOwned in _transferStandard.
The recipient parameter indexes _rOwned in _transferStandard.
tAmount is the input to _getValues.
currentRate scales the team fee into reflections.
manualsend passes the contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee.
rAmount is subtracted from the sender's reflection balance.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount in the cooldown branch.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee and swap behavior.
_transfer gates the automatic swap on swapEnabled.
_transfer checks inSwap before triggering the swap.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] using block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
_getValues calls _getRate to convert token to reflection amounts.
_getValues obtains supplies via _getCurrentSupply indirectly through _getRate.
_getCurrentSupply supplies rSupply and tSupply to the rate division.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tTotal as the token supply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply.
_transferStandard calls _getValues for the amount tuple.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for approval and swap.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through the _allowances mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter consumed only by the _transfer function.
to is a parameter consumed only by the _transfer function.
amount is a parameter validated inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a local computed in _transfer and consumed by swapTokensForEth.
tokenAmount is the swap input parameter of swapTokensForEth.
path is the local swap path built in swapTokensForEth.
amount is the parameter forwarded to the ETH transfer unsafe operation.
bots_ is the blacklist array parameter of nonosquare.
i is the loop counter local of nonosquare.
notbot is the address parameter of delBot.
onoff is the boolean parameter of setCooldownEnabled.
sender is a caller-supplied parameter of transferFrom.
recipient is a parameter of transferFrom.
amount is the allowance-consuming parameter of transferFrom.
sender is the indexed parameter of _transferStandard.
recipient is the indexed parameter of _transferStandard.
tAmount is the amount parameter of _transferStandard.
currentRate is the local rate used by _takeTeam.
contractETHBalance is the local balance forwarded to sendETHToFee.
rAmount is the reflection amount local computed in _transferStandard.
